purpose: Post-hoc ESM-2 modality diagnostic on the already observed internal homology-cold test
claim_boundary: The frozen internal test and full-model results were observed before this protocol. These runs diagnose modality contribution under matched training settings; they are not independent confirmation or a new model-selection surface.
parameter_recovery: Model configuration, initial learning rate, source/split identities, and seeds were recovered from existing best/latest checkpoints. Batch size, accumulation, warmup, cosine schedule, and patience are documented in the manuscript; ten epochs is the predeclared cap, consistent with observed early-stop epochs 5/6/7.

evaluation.summary: Mean and sample SD across seeds; paired per-seed differences against the unmodified full-model reference. No hyperparameter changes based on test results.
